verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE
height represents the centre of each pixel
grid tile has 200 rows and 200 columns
height values are supplied to nearest 0.1m
grid GML carries location grid spacing and vertical reference metadata
metadata identifies EPSG 27700 British National Grid
metadata identifies EPSG 5701 Ordnance Datum Newlyn
metadata can record earliest and latest flying dates in a tile
OS Terrain 50 is lower resolution and intended for broad landscape analysis rather than parcel-precision measurement
quality_effect: Keeps OS Terrain 50 as a coarse independent corroboration source and requires per-tile date, CRS and vertical-reference metadata before comparison with EA LiDAR.
